Report DescriptionINCIDENT TYPE: MEDIUM COASTAL POLLUTION LOCATION: IZHUT BAY, AK. (58-09.020N 152-18.216W) TIME INCIDENT OCCURRED: 01 SEP 1439 ZULU / 1039 EDT TIME OF INITIAL REPORT TO NCC: 1905 ZULU / 1505 EDT NAME OF REPORTING UNIT: USCG SECTOR WESTERN ALASKA AMPLIFYING INFORMATION: • ON 01 SEPTEMBER, FISHING VESSEL (F/V) SEA ERIN (U.S. FLAG) SUSTAINED A 12 FOOT BY 1 FOOT PUNCTURE FROM A SUBMERGED ROCK IN IZHUT BAY, AK. • THE FORWARD HULL WAS RUPTURED, AND THE VESSEL BEGAN TAKING ON WATER. • THE F/V SEA ERIN BEACHED THE VESSEL. ALL THREE PERSONS ON BOARD WERE ACCOUNTED FOR. • DURING THEIR INVESTIGATION, MARINE SAFETY UNIT KODIAK, AK DISCOVERED THE TWO FORWARD FUEL TANKS WERE PUNCTURED. • AN APPROXIMATE 3,500 GALLONS OF DIESEL HAS BEEN SPILLED WITH A POTENTIAL OF ANOTHER 6,000 ON BOARD. • MSU KODIAK CONFIRMS THE OTHER FUEL TANKS ARE SECURED TO PREVENT SPILLAGE. • BOOM HAS BEEN DEPLOYED TO WITH MORE ENROUTE WITH AN ARRIVAL TIME OF 1400 AKDT. • OIL SPILL RECOVERY ORGANIZATION IS CURRENTLY BEING SELECTED. • FISH AND GAME HAVE CLOSED OUT COMMERCIAL FISHING FOR SURROUNDING AREAS. • A FOLLOW-ON CIC IS SCHEDULED FOR 0200 ZULU TIME (2200 EDT)
